subject: KiteWing live demo — scheduling paused pending vendor intake
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@kitewing.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@kitewing.com
Date: 2026-11-24T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request to schedule demo — KiteWing / Redwood

Hi Rafael / Ben,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — KiteWing is keen to see Redwood in action. We were hoping to schedule a 45-minute live demo in early December (ideally week of Dec 7). Quick note from our side: procurement and security require completion of our vendor intake before any executive demo — specifically the security questionnaire, an executed NDA, and SSO onboarding details. Our CISO (Tom) will be traveling Nov 29–Dec 5, so decisioning and exec availability is likely the week of Dec 13.

I’m looping in procurement to share the intake checklist. Can you send any pre-read security artifacts (SOC2 summary, encryption details) and confirm whether you can complete a short vendor-portal form? If procurement signs off quickly we can aim for Dec 7, otherwise we’ll need to move the demo out.

Thanks —
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Product Ops, KiteWing
[Attachment: KiteWing_Vendor_Checklist_Template.xlsx]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@kitewing.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule demo — KiteWing / Redwood

Hi Alyssa — great to hear. We can absolutely accommodate procurement gating. I’ve attached our onboarding instructions and a short SOC2 summary to help speed things along.

If it helps, next steps we can take from our side:
- Share SOC2 summary + encryption FAQ (attached).
- Send a short (20min) recorded product overview immediately so your team can review while procurement completes the questionnaire.
- Schedule a brief intake call with our security ops to walk the portal fields (15 min).

I’m flexible on dates — if Tom is unavailable until Dec 6, we can hold Dec 14/15 as options. Would you prefer we send the recorded overview first and keep a tentative hold on Dec 14?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Instructions.pdf]

From: procurement@kitewing.com
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@kitewing.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request to schedule demo — KiteWing / Redwood

Rafael — thanks. We’ve started the intake and attached a partially completed questionnaire (still working through encryption-at-rest specifics). Per our policy, we need an executed NDA before we can book an exec-level demo.

Provisional timeline: we will review vendor docs this week; Tom’s travel means final confirmation is most likely the week of Dec 13. If you can provide the SOC2 summary + any artifact showing data residency controls, that will help us expedite.

Attachment: KiteWing_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx
Procurement (KiteWing)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@kitewing.com; Alyssa Chen <alyssa@kitewing.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule demo — KiteWing / Redwood

Thanks for the update — understood on the NDA requirement.

Quick plan from our side:
- We will NOT book an executive demo until procurement confirms intake is complete.
- I’ll send over a 20-minute product overview recording today so your team can continue evaluation while procurement completes the checklist.
- Marissa (solutions/security) will share our SOC2 summary and a one-page data-residency note.

Marissa — assigning you to pull the SOC2 summary and respond to the questionnaire items on the attached worksheet. Rafael, I’ll keep you posted on any procurement questions.

—Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@kitewing.com>; procurement@kitewing.com
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule demo — KiteWing / Redwood

Hi Alyssa / Team — copying resources you requested.

I’ve attached our SOC2 summary and a concise FAQ addressing data residency and encryption-at-rest. For the NDA, I created a DocuSign envelope and included a short vendor intake checklist link below; please sign and we’ll confirm the intake ticket.

Proposed slots once procurement confirms:
- Tue Dec 14, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Dec 15, 14:00–14:45 PT

If those don’t work, we can move the demo to early January.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf
DocuSign NDA: https://docusign.com/link/ND A-KW-2026
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/KW-2026-11

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@kitewing.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; procurement@kitewing.com
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@kitewing.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T16:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule demo — KiteWing / Redwood

Marissa / team — thanks, that helps a lot. I’ve routed the DocuSign to the legal inbox and asked procurement to prioritize the questionnaire. Tom’s travel schedule means Dec 14 is our preferred target if procurement confirms tomorrow. Please go ahead and send the recorded overview for internal review; we’ll hold a tentative calendar slot for Dec 14 and will confirm formally once the NDA and intake are complete.

Action items agreed:
- Redwood: send 20-min recorded overview + any short artifacts (SOC2 summary provided).
- KiteWing procurement: finish questionnaire + execute NDA (aim: EOD 11/28).
- If procurement cannot finish by EOB 11/28 we’ll shift to week of Dec 13/Jan 2027.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the overview.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Product Ops, KiteWing
